title: The 'call the door's fate a draw' mediation option between Tamsin and Brother Osk is a will check, but as a Scout (no will investment) it failed (rolled 9 vs DC11) and left the quarrel permanently unresolved, confirmed by the ending epilogue ('Osk and Tamsin never settled it'). The only realistic option for a non-Envoy build is to pick a side.
where: Vale / The Empty Seat, Brother Osk vs Tamsin quarrel over the barrow doors
